{{Quote|A sparsely inhabited planet in the neighboring Handooine system has become a Republic staging area for a military engagement likely to start within the standard month.|HoloNet News Core Edition report|<ref name="Insider68" />}}
'''Handooine''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located on the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] as part of the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]]. Known as '''Gwynhes''' during the [[Xim's empire|reign]] of the conqueror [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] twenty [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Handooine was a sparsely populated world. During that conflict, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] used Handooine as a [[Staging area/Legends|staging area]] for its upcoming [[Battle of Jabiim|military campaign]] on the nearby planet [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]]. [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] agents also introduced a [[Computer virus/Legends|computer virus]] onto the Republic's prototype [[Tector-class Star Destroyer|''Tector''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Gibbon]]'' at Handooine at some point during the war.

==Description==
{{Quote|They make noises about peaceful resolutions, but only once their army is amassed a short hyperspace jump away.|[[Jabiimi]] [[Spokesbeing]] [[Alto Stratus]] on the Galactic Republic|<ref name="Insider68" />}}
Handooine was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with [[Color/Legends|gray]]-and-blue-colored [[Atmosphere/Legends|skies]] that was located in the [[Handooine system/Legends|Handooine system]],<ref name="Insider68" /> a part of the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]]<ref name="EAOC Handooine" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC Handooine" /> It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], which connected it to the [[Jabiim system/Legends|Jabiim]] and [[Trasemene system/Legends|Trasemene systems]] as well as the [[Sy Myrth system/Legends|Sy Myrth system]]<ref name="Triellus" /> of the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> In particular, Handooine was located only a short [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump away from the planet [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]].<ref name="Insider68" />

==History==
{{Quote|On Handooine, the amassed fighting forces wait patiently for the order to strike.|HoloNet News Core Edition report|<ref name="Insider68" />}}
[[File:Gwynhes-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|During the reign of Xim, Handooine was known as Gwynhes.]]
Between [[25,120 BBY]] and [[25,096 BBY]], Handooine was known as Gwynhes and was situated in the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Kiirium Reaches]] region, a part of the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] conqueror [[Xim/Legends|Xim]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], Xim moved his forces from the [[Altratonne system/Legends|Kveror system]] to Gwynhes, and additionally the Tionese military advanced through Gwynhes on its way from the Far Barseg [[Star system/Legends|system]]—which would later be known as the Sy Myrth system—to the Gwynhes Minor system—the later Jabiim system.<ref name="TEA" />

By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Handooine was a sparsely populated world. Before its planned [[Battle of Jabiim|campaign]] on the planet Jabiim, the Republic used Handooine as a [[Staging area/Legends|staging area]] for its [[Republic Military/Legends|military forces]]. Hundreds of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]], [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]], and [[All Terrain Experimental Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] were being carefully prepared and maintained for rapid deployment from there to Jabiim at a moment's notice.<ref name="Insider68" />

In addition, multiple [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Republic gunships]] and numerous [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were also present on the planet, with the arrival of<ref name="Insider68" /> the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]]<ref name="CSWE Dominance">{{CSWECite|I|196|''Dominance''}}</ref> [[Dominance (Acclamator-class)|''Dominance'']] and its [[Troop/Legends|troops]] bringing the number of [[Trooper/Legends|soldiers]] on Handooine up to an entire [[Corps/Legends|corps]]. At one point, a [[HoloNet News Core Edition]] report on the situation on Handooine and Jabiim was transmitted from the former planet's<ref name="Insider68" /> [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Jelwick]].<ref name="CSWE Jelwick" /> The [[HoloNet News/Legends|news]] report estimated that it was likely the invasion of Jabiim would occur within a [[Standard month/Legends|standard month]],<ref name="Insider68" /> and the operation indeed began in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>

The prototype [[Tector-class Star Destroyer|''Tector''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Gibbon]]'' was one of a handful of such [[Star Destroyer/Legends|vessels]] assigned during the Clone Wars to Republic live-fire exercises before their formal production had commenced. When the ''Gibbon'' was stationed at Handooine, Separatist agents introduced a [[Computer virus/Legends|computer virus]] aboard the [[Warship/Legends|warship]]. The virus replicated itself throughout [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kreuge]]'s [[Task force/Legends|task force]], contributing to a Republic defeat at the subsequent [[Battle of Salvara]].<ref name="Season1">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref> By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Handooine was undecided on its affiliation to either the Republic or the Confederacy.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|139|WOR 1-2|Worlds of the Clone Wars}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Handooine was first mentioned in "[[Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:7:02]]," an article written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] as an [[HoloNet News (Insider)|in-universe news report]]. It was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 68|sixty-eighth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider68" /> on [[May 12]], [[2003]].<ref name="Insider date">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/05/news20030512.html|text=Zahn Returns in ''Insider'' #68}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Handooine system, and therefore the planet itself, in grid square S-7.<ref name="TEA" />
